notes: Facts confirmed 2026-09-10 from the church's own site, journeyefc.org. ADDRESS RESOLVED: 4700 N Swan Rd, Tucson AZ 85718 really is the church - it appears in the site footer next to the church phone (520) 299-1660 - so the earlier worry that it was an EFCA regional office was unfounded. Affiliation confirmed on the About page: 'Journey Church's core doctrines are the ten Statements of Faith of the Evangelical Free Church of America, our affiliated denomination.' PASTORS CORRECTED: the About page's Pastors section lists only Jim Roden (Lead Pastor since 2003; D.Min. Biola, M.Div. Western Seminary) and Tyler Hurst (Associate Pastor since 2021; PhD Southern Baptist Seminary, M.A. Talbot). The previously seeded 'Brian Klimke' was removed - no primary source on the church's site lists him. Note the /pastors URL is now a 404; the bios live under /about and are lazily loaded, so a plain fetch may show an empty 'Pastors' heading. The sermon podcast on Podbean also shows a third preacher, Micah Coate, who is not on the staff page - attribute sermons individually. Sermon media: YouTube @JourneyChurchTucson (channel UC7Yh-RYbPYXjSIjns7PIw0w, described as 'Journey Church Tucson / An Evangelical Free Church / Tucson, AZ', so the channel identity is confirmed) and journeychurchtucson.podbean.com. Jim Roden also published an academic case study about this church, which is a useful independent writing sample for AI-signal comparison. Coordinates still need tools/geocode.py.
